column1: Table 4: The 15 companies: sector, country, market capitalisation and 10-year beta

Market cap: Yahoo Finance 'marketCap' via yfinance, USD billions, retrieved 2026-11-04 12:48:25 UTC (a current snapshot, not a sample-period value); GOOGL and META include all share classes; TSM (ADR) and ASML (NY shares) are Yahoo's USD values for the whole company.

10-year beta: OLS slope of each stock's 120 monthly simple returns (Oct 2016 - Sep 2026) on the monthly returns of the S&P 500 Total Return index (^SP500TR), beta = Cov(Ri, Rm) / Var(Rm) (eq. 18). Sector = GICS sector; country = headquarters.

Source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance 1.2.0; daily prices adjusted for splits and dividends (auto_adjust=True), downloaded 2026-11-04 11:32:29 UTC. Sample: last-trading-day month-end prices 30 Sep 2016 to 30 Sep 2026, i.e. 120 monthly simple returns (Oct 2016 - Sep 2026). Currency: USD (all 15 are US listings; no currency conversion). Annualisation: mean x 12, SD x sqrt(12), covariance x 12.
